name: Celesteela
how: A roaming Ultra Beast: it can appear anywhere in the overworld at night under the open sky, very rarely, at level 55-60. A full moon makes it much likelier.
Moves, stats, typing and ability are the official Ultra Sun/Ultra Moon ones (Heavy Slam at 60). It flies and can't walk.
Commands: /pokespawn celesteela or /pokegive celesteela (add 'shiny' for the shiny).
look: Pale sea-green arm-rockets with white straps, cyan frills and glowing nozzle rims and tips, a striped sage cloak and a white segmented spire. It hovers, leans into flight, aims its arms to fire Flash Cannon and drops onto foes with Heavy Slam. Shiny: pearl white with rose-gold frills and an orange glow.
